problem: Identify feature gaps in helix-cli that represent new feature opportunities. CLI is the command-line workbench for Helix.

files.why: Inspection commands (db, logs, api) — mature feature, well-implemented.
Ticket management commands — list, get, create, rerun, continue, artifacts. Covers main workflows.
Goal commands exist (create, list, get, terminate) but backend Goal table doesn't exist in production.
Comment commands — list and post. No notification management via CLI.

facts.claim: CLI is published as @projectxinnovation/helix-cli v1.3.4 on npm
CLI has commands for: login, token, org, tickets, goals, inspect, comments, library, skill, preview, update
Goal CLI commands exist but point at non-existent backend (Goal table missing in production)
facts.source: CLI source + production DB table listing

facts.claim: No notification management commands exist in the CLI
No analytics or usage reporting commands exist in the CLI

unknowns: Whether CLI users need notification management (dismiss, configure preferences) from the command line
Whether CLI-based search is needed or if users primarily search via the web UI
